source: Statistics Bureau of Japan, Family Income and Expenditure Survey (FIES) 2024, Workers' Households (勤労者世帯), Table 3 (Average of Monthly Receipts and Disbursements per Household by Yearly Income Decile Group)
notes: REAL PRIMARY DATA from Japan Statistics Bureau FIES 2024 annual report (released Aug 2025), sheet 2 of s03.xls ('勤労' = Workers' Households), which is the FIES subsample with full income-statement detail (gross income, direct tax, social insurance, disposable income) broken out by yearly income decile (年間収入十分位階級, columns 十I-十X). The 'Total Households' sheet (総世帯, sheet 1) was NOT used as the primary source because it lacks the tax/social-insurance/disposable-income breakdown needed for this schema -- it only reports gross annual income and consumption expenditure. Workers' households is a reasonable proxy for 'all consumer units' per convention in Japanese household-economics literature, though it skews toward employed (non-retired, non-self-employed-outlier) households; it excludes single-person and retiree-only households that are captured elsewhere in FIES's broader panel. Values are MONTHLY yen in the source table; this file annualizes them by x12 for avg_income_before_tax/after_tax/avg_expenditure_total, but expenditure_by_category values are ALSO annualized (x12) from the source's monthly figures for internal consistency with avg_expenditure_total. CATEGORY MAPPING (Japanese FIES codes -> v2 schema): housing = row '住居' (rent/home-repair-maintenance, EXCLUDES utilities) + row '光熱・水道' (fuel/light/water utilities), combined to match BLS CES's broader 'housing' bucket which also includes utilities; food_at_home = '食料' (Food total) minus '外食' (eating out); food_away = '外食' (eating out / dining out); healthcare_oop = '保健医療' (medical products + medical services, out-of-pocket; excludes health-insurance premiums, which are captured separately under 社会保険料/social insurance -- NOT included here, matching BLS OOP convention); transport_work = '自動車等関係費' (vehicle-related costs: purchase, maintenance, fuel) used as best-available proxy for work-commute transport since JP FIES does not separately tag commuting vs. discretionary vehicle use; transport_total = '交通・通信' (transport+communications combined) minus '通信' (communications) = transport alone (includes public transit fares, vehicle costs, etc.); apparel = '被服及び履物' (clothing & footwear); communications = '通信' (postal, telecom, internet); personal_care = null -- JP FIES does not break out personal care/grooming as a top-level category at this table's granularity (folded into 'その他の消費支出'/other-consumption's 諸雑費 subcategory, which includes personal-care services/products alongside pocket money, gifts, etc. -- cannot be cleanly separated without the more granular item-level table, which was not fetched in this pass); education = '教育' (school fees, tutoring, textbooks); childcare = null -- not a distinct FIES category (childcare costs are split across education/other depending on service type; no dedicated line item); voluntary_savings = null -- FIES tracks net financial-asset flows (預貯金 net change) as a receipts/disbursements concept, not a 'voluntary retirement savings' expenditure category comparable to BLS's iRA/401k contributions concept; leaving null per do-not-fabricate rule; entertainment = '教養娯楽' (culture & recreation, incl. media, hobbies, travel, admission fees); other = 'その他の消費支出' (other consumption expenditure: miscellaneous goods/services, personal-care, pocket money, social/gift expenses, remittances -- a residual bucket similar to BLS's 'other' but broader in scope since it absorbs personal_care and part of childcare-adjacent gifting). avg_income_before_tax = '実収入' (actual income: all recurring earned + transfer income, excludes borrowing/asset drawdowns which JP separately reports under '実収入以外の受取'). avg_income_after_tax = '可処分所得' (disposable income = actual income minus non-consumption expenditure, i.e. minus direct tax + social insurance premiums), which is Japan's official disposable-income definition and directly analogous to BLS 'income after taxes'. housing_owner_share = '持家率' (home-ownership rate, %) reported per decile in the source table -- REAL data, not imputed. housing_owner_imputed_rent_estimate = null (FIES headline tables do not publish imputed rent; Japan's SNA imputed-rent estimates exist at the aggregate/national level only, not disaggregated by income decile). CAVEAT: 'Workers' households' (勤労者世帯, ~55-60% of all Japanese households) excludes retiree households and self-employed/agricultural households, which have materially different income/expenditure profiles (esp. lower or zero direct employment income). This is a scope limitation inherited from the source table structure, not a modeling choice -- Japan's 'Total Households' decile table (sheet 1 of the same file) does NOT publish the tax/disposable-income breakdown needed for this schema, forcing the workers'-households subsample as the only viable Tier-A (real, primary-source, by-decile) option with complete required fields.
